findings: C-F1 ROOT CAUSE OF SUCCESSOR-8 (bed_gain_db is not a scalar) - FOUND, by inspection, pending browser proof. synth.js attachMod() line 139-143: for mod.target==='gain' it reads base = targets.gain.gain.value (which at that moment is only dbToGain(synth.gain_db)), sets the static value to base*(1-depth/2) and sets the LFO SWING AMOUNT amt.gain.value = base*depth/2, then CONNECTS amt to the gain AudioParam. An AudioParam connection is ADDITIVE. ambience.js buildBedContinuous() line 374 then does h.gain.gain.value = h.gain.gain.value * dbToGain(level_db) * trim -- which scales ONLY THE STATIC TERM. The LFO swing is never scaled. So gain(t) = base*(1-d/2)*L*trim + sin(2*pi*f*t)*base*(d/2): one term follows the trim and the other does not. bed_gain_db is therefore a scalar on part of the signal and a no-op on the rest, which is exactly 'does not behave as a scalar'.

C-F2 C-F1 PREDICTS ALL THREE OF THE BUILDER'S NUMBERS, INCLUDING THE SIGN OF THE CENTROID MOVE. valus-ridge L1 is a DRONE at 146.83/174.61/220/261.63 Hz with mod {target:'gain', depth:0.42, lfo_hz:0.11} -- low frequency, gain-modulated. Its L2 is a 2400 Hz highpass with mod {target:'filter_hz'} -- high frequency, NOT gain-modulated. Lower the trim and the high L2 attenuates by the full amount while the low L1 attenuates by less, because L1's unscaled LFO term stays put. So (a) loudness moves LESS than the trim (-1.42 vs -2.06 OK), (b) peak moves least of all because the peak is set by the LFO crest (-0.92 OK), (c) the surviving energy is relatively MORE low-frequency, so the centroid FALLS (2057.8 -> 1925.1 OK). No other mechanism in the file predicts a falling centroid.

C-F3 THE SAME BUG MAKES level_db NON-SCALAR TOO, and it is worse than a calibration nuisance. dbToGain(level_db) is applied on the same line as trim, so an L2 sublayer's declared level_db does not scale its modulation either. At valus-ridge's trim of -15.3 dB (the largest magnitude of the thirteen), L1's static term is base*0.79*0.1717 = base*0.1357 while its LFO swing is base*0.21 -- the swing is 1.55x the static value, so the gain parameter goes NEGATIVE on every LFO trough and the layer PHASE-INVERTS at 0.11 Hz. A declared 42% tremolo has become a 155% inverting one. synth.js's own comment says the gain case is biased 'so that a depth: 1.0 gain modulation reaches silence at the trough rather than clipping at the peak' -- that intent is defeated by the later multiplication, and the bigger the trim the more it is defeated. Ranking by |trim| predicts which beds drift most: valus-ridge -15.30 (worst, and it is the one that drifted), stone-forest -11.24 (second, also gain-modded L1).

C-F4 THE BUG IS ON THE LIVE PATH TOO, not only in the measurement path. buildBedContinuous() is called by BOTH renderBedOffline() and AmbienceDriver._swapLive(), so what a player would hear has the same inverted-tremolo layers. It is not a measurement artefact.

C-F5 REMEDY IS THREE LINES: give buildContinuous an explicit output scalar (or apply level_db+trim BEFORE attachMod, or scale amt.gain.value by the same factor in buildBedContinuous). Then --calibrate's one-shot linear correction becomes correct and does not need iterating.

C-F6 BIGGEST GAP -- THE R7 POSITIONAL EMITTERS ARE SILENT ON EVERY PATH. buildGrain() has exactly three call sites (grep): ambience.js:241 (live L3/L4), ambience.js:425 (offline L3/L4) and ambience.js:437 (offline EMITTERS, gated on opts.listener). AmbienceDriver.step()'s emitter block (lines 253-263) computes emitterPlacement into this.emitterState, increments the voice count, and SCHEDULES NO AUDIO AT ALL. And no caller anywhere in the tree passes `listener` to ambienceCapture()/renderBedOffline() -- ambience-render.mjs calls ambienceCapture({region,seconds,sampleRate,tod}) with no listener, thirteen times, so opts.listener is null in every render this project has ever taken. Consequence: the bell buoy, the legion horn, the kiln and the hide-drum have never been rendered into PCM, are not in any measured spectrum, and CANNOT BE HEARD IN THE GAME. What exists is emitterPlacement(), a pure function of position that writes pan and gain into an observation surface nothing consumes. That is the CONSUMPTION defect in ARBITRATION S3 verbatim: a model computed every frame into a trace with no world-side consumer. RI-MTH07: unmeasurable => 0.

C-F7 B6 AS SPECIFIED WAS NOT RUN. RI-AUD03 B6 says 'assert audioLog.pan and gain vary monotonically'. AmbienceDriver._emit() is called only for region_change and ambience_event (L3/L4) rows -- there is no emitter row in ambienceLog(), ever. The builder's G7 reads ambienceEmitters(), a separate pure-geometry surface, not the audio log. G7 is a correct and well-built test OF THE ARITHMETIC and it is not B6.

C-F8 SEAM CONSEQUENCE OF C-F6. RI-AUD03's own AR-3 seam #1 is 'Ambience is the S8 wayfinding instrument -- the player navigates by ear where markers are forbidden.' A landmark that makes no sound carries no position. The piece's single strongest seam-crossing claim is not carried by the running build.

C-F9 THE ITEM'S NAMED B4 TOOL IS A FLAG THAT LIES. RI-AUD03 B4 names `node tools/analysis/content-stats.mjs --audio game/data/audio/ambience/`. That file EXISTS, accepts the flag, IGNORES it and the positional path, runs the generic content census and EXITS 0. A critic executing the item's method verbatim records B4 as passing having checked none of B4's four assertions. TOOL-LOOP rule 3 item 5: 'a flag that lies is worse than a missing flag' (the cmb-reach.mjs --verify precedent). The builder did the right thing under TOOL-LOOP rule 1 by writing tools/analysis/ambience-census.mjs, but left the phantom armed and did not amend the item.

C-F10 B4 RE-DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY (my own python census, not the builder's tool, at ead0e35): 13 regions in regions.json, 13 beds on disk, 0 missing, 0 orphan, all four layer keys present in all 13, 13/13 unique L1 ids, every L3 interval inside [8,40] and every L4 inside [45,180] including stone-forest's night_interval_s. B4 = PASS, agreeing with the builder. My instrument was broken on purpose five ways and went red on four (duplicate L1, L4 out of band, deleted layer key, deleted bed).

C-F11 THE FIFTH SABOTAGE DID NOT GO RED, AND THAT IS THE ITEM'S FAULT NOT THE BUILD'S: setting western-rootlands' L3 interval to [15,15] passes B4, because 15 s is inside the 8-40 s band. RI-AUD03's own 'How we lose' names 'someone raises the rate to every 15 seconds' as the signature-becomes-wallpaper failure and says '§A L3/L4 interval bands are checked in B4 for this reason'. They are not sufficient to catch it.

C-F12 AND THE SIGNATURES ARE NOT L3 ANY MORE, SO NO BAND CHECK REACHES THEM AT ALL. The builder correctly moved the hide-drum from L3 to an R7 emitter to resolve a real contradiction between RI-AUD03 SectionA (L3 capped at 8-40 s) and SectionB (a 90-second beat). Emitter `period_s` is bounded by nothing in ambience-census.mjs (C8 checks only that the emitters exist and the buoy's audible_m). Measured periods on disk: hide_drum 90 (matches SectionB), legion_horn 3600 (matches 'on the hour'), kiln NO period_s AT ALL (renderBedOffline defaults it to 20), bell_buoy 13. THE BELL BUOY RINGS EVERY 13 SECONDS -- more often than the 15 s the item names as the failure mode, 92 times in a twenty-minute walk, and no check in the piece or the corpus looks at it.

C-F13 R5 (night is a different selection) IS UNMEASURED. Every capture in ambience-render.mjs is taken with tod:'day'. Six night-only L2 sublayers (blackwood, marauders-coast x2, western-rootlands) and every night-gated L3/L4 event are therefore absent from all thirteen rendered spectra, from the separation proxy, from the level gate and from the spectra sidecar region-axes now consumes. Nothing in the piece has ever rendered the night world.

b2_preregistration.declared_before: any clip was rendered, any pack was built, any judge was dispatched
b2_preregistration.why_this_section_exists: Two earlier blind comparisons in this project were voided because the pack was built by the agent that answered it, and a third because it asked a provenance question where the item specifies a quality one. RI-AUD03 B2 asks a QUALITY/IDENTITY question (same place or different places?) and nothing else. This block is written first so the design cannot be retro-fitted to the result.
b2_preregistration.item_spec: RI-AUD03 B2: 78 fresh judges, two 20 s clips each, prompt verbatim 'Are these two 20-second recordings from the same place in a game world, or different places? Answer SAME or DIFFERENT and give one sentence of reason.' separation = (# correctly answered DIFFERENT)/78. Pass >= 0.80. Hard fail < 0.50.
b2_preregistration.stimulus_deviation_declared_up_front: An LLM judge has no ears and this box has no audio path to a judge. The clip is therefore presented as a MECHANICALLY DERIVED, LABEL-FREE rendering of the actual PCM the engine produced: (a) a log-frequency spectrogram PNG, (b) a numeric acoustic profile (24 log-spaced band levels in dB, LUFS-I, spectral centroid, transient onset times with GENERIC descriptors only). Both members of every pair go through the identical rendering path, so the transformation cannot itself be a tell. This is weaker than listening and is declared as a method_deviation; it is stronger than the builder's separation_proxy because a judge, not a cosine threshold, decides.

sampling_declared_in_advance.design: STRATIFIED SAMPLE of the 78 unordered pairs, not the full census, plus SAME-pair catch trials the item itself does not specify.
sampling_declared_in_advance.hard_stratum: the 12 pairs with the SMALLEST spectral distance in the builder's own reports/w1-22/ambience-render.json closest-pair ordering, extended by re-deriving the full 78-pair distance matrix myself. These are the pairs where a false pass would hide.
sampling_declared_in_advance.random_stratum: 12 further pairs drawn uniformly without replacement from the remaining 66, seed 22071 (recorded here before drawing).
sampling_declared_in_advance.catch_stratum: 8 SAME pairs: one region rendered twice at two DIFFERENT capture seeds. RI-AUD03 B2 AS WRITTEN HAS NO SAME CONTROL - all 78 pairs are genuinely different regions, so a judge that answers DIFFERENT to everything scores separation = 1.000. That is a probe that cannot fail, and the item ships it. The catch trials are my addition and are declared as a method_deviation.
sampling_declared_in_advance.seed_hygiene: every trial uses a different capture seed for A than for B, drawn from seed 22071, so 'same seed' is never a channel and a SAME pair is never the identical file.
sampling_declared_in_advance.interpretation_rule_fixed_in_advance: because the hard stratum is adversarially selected, the sample separation is a LOWER BOUND on the full-78 figure and will be reported as such. It will NOT be quoted as the full-78 B2 number. If false_different_rate on the catch stratum exceeds 0.25 the whole B2 result is declared INADMISSIBLE and the item falls back to non-blind scoring, per RI-MTH03's own scoring band.

b2_preregistration.judge_freshness: Judges are dispatched as separate contexts that receive ONLY the pack directory (A.png, B.png, A.txt, B.txt, PROMPT.md) and are told nothing else. I have read RI-AUD03 SectionB and therefore know what each region is supposed to sound like; I am DISQUALIFIED as a judge and will not answer any trial myself. That disqualification is the exact failure RI-AUD03 names ('The blind test is run by someone who has read this file').
unblinding_order_declared_in_advance: 1. re-derive the 78-pair distance matrix and fix the hard stratum
2. draw the random and catch strata from seed 22071 and write reports/w1-22-critic/b2/manifest.json (trial ids only, NO region names)
3. write the reveal key to reports/w1-22-critic/b2.reveal/mapping.json - a SIBLING of the pack root, never a child
4. render every clip, build every pack directory
5. dispatch judges; every answer lands in <pack>/answer.md
6. concatenate all answers into answers.jsonl and record its sha256 IN THE VERDICT
7. ONLY THEN open b2.reveal/mapping.json and score
I will not read mapping.json before step 7. The sha256 of answers.jsonl is the auditable evidence of that ordering.
